change: In the compact <=128-bond Morgan expansion, replace per-neighborhood binary search of the sorted previous-layer prefix with one monotone scan. Keep round sorting, group winners, death lifecycle, old-prefix length, emission order and final seen sorting unchanged.
target: Repeated-use chiral Morgan, while retaining all first-use and parse-inclusive work
orders: All 24 permutations of baseline/candidate/rdkit/cosmolkit once per profile, shuffled with seeds 20261017+offset before any formal timing. Every position occurs six times per arm.
first_use: Fresh parsing outside every timed full batch; operation called once on every fresh molecule. Rebuild before the next batch.
repeated_use: Prepare one fresh full batch and run one untimed operation on each molecule, then repeat the same requested operation on those prepared objects. Do not label this first-use or parse-inclusive.
parse_inclusive: Fresh parsing and operation inside each timed full-batch loop.
warmup: Initialize each selected operation on disjoint first-row objects, outside formal timings; no timed object reused in first-use or parse-inclusive modes.
timing: Sum of independently timed complete batches / actual batch count, with each raw batch duration and actual processed rows retained. Preparation and output normalization/checking between batches are outside accumulated operation time. This is not a contiguous steady-state or cold-start measurement.
output_validation: Normalize outside every timed batch; all values must equal the same engine's first batch for every mode and iteration. Store complete canonical row outputs per arm plus per-batch output digests; compare source exactly, external numeric descriptors with absolute tolerance1e-9 and fingerprint bits/ring counts exactly. Retain errors/refusals/mismatches; never filter rows.
timed_return_boundary: Each public API's native result, including chematic bytes and comparator fingerprint objects. Canonical on-bit conversion outside timing. Whole-process RSS includes imports/preparation/validation and is not ranked.
adoption: Both primary source paired bootstrap CI lower bounds>1, all42 unrounded source median ratios>=0.99, complete experiments and exact source outputs including broad normal/unusual-input validation. No exception.
external_claim_gate: Each lane needs equivalent outputs, paired95% CI lower>1 and24/24 faster blocks. Fresh external timings cover only the three Morgan operations; controls compare source only.
statistics: 10000 paired bootstrap resamples with fixed seeds; raw unrounded paired medians decide retention; retain every negative interval.
build: Baseline starts in an empty target. Candidate may reuse unchanged dependency cache, but changed production libraries must actually recompile and their code realization be verified; distinct wheel/extension hashes and complete source manifests retained. Same release flags and interpreter.
persistence: Atomic per-arm journals; predeclare no performance-informed reruns or pooling. An interrupted experiment remains incomplete and cannot be adopted.
scope: One macOS arm64 host, CPython3.13, pinned installed RDKit2026.09.1/COSMolKit0.5.0. Source wheels, exposed development corpus, no published-package, cross-host or universal superiority claim. No earlier elapsed samples reused.
